items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, yeah, I heard him. ... Then after Bix got with Paul Whiteman, we used to listen to him a lot, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. And what kind of people did you run into, that you'd say were maybe influences or at least people to listen to?
Well, we'd run into people like Paul Whiteman, you know... They'd play in different places.
Would they allow Black people to go in and hear Paul Whiteman?
